assessment: This valuable study carried out a genetic screening of Drosophila lines expressing wild-type or ALS/FTD mutations of ubiquilin 2 and identified several suppressors and enhancers of ubiquilin 2 phenotypes. The study particularly focused on two genes involved in axon guidance pathways, unc5, and beat-1b. The evidence supporting the conclusions is solid and will be of interest to a broad audience studying ALS/FTD and neurodegenerative diseases.
